purpose: Preliminary physicochemical screening of pure SAF-relevant hydrocarbons from seven molecular descriptors.

seed_policy.nested_cv: base_seed + 100 * target_index + 10 * model_index + outer_fold_number; target_index/model_index are zero-based in model_order and outer_fold_number is 1..5
seed_policy.final_fit: base_seed + 9000 + deployment_index; deployment_index is zero-based in final_fit_target_order. Y02 is appended so v1.0.0 seeds for Y01 and Y03-Y07 remain unchanged.

X02.name: H/C atomic ratio
X02.definition: Hydrogen atom count divided by carbon atom count

X03.name: Aromatic carbon fraction
X03.definition: Aromatic carbon count divided by total carbon count

X05.name: Branching-carbon count
X05.definition: Carbon atoms directly connected to at least three carbon atoms

X06.name: Graph-automorphism descriptor
X06.definition: ln(1 + graph automorphism match count), ignoring stereochemistry

interval_method: Symmetric 90% and 95% empirical intervals from molecular-formula-group maxima of nested-CV out-of-fold absolute residuals.
applicability_method: mean L1 distance after median and 5th-95th percentile scaling
y02_policy: Y02 is predicted by its separately fitted deployment model trained on 162 identity-resolved independent responses in 66 molecular-formula groups.
limitations: The held-out test set is not read by this training and export entry point.
Y02 labels were independently collected, but row-level primary-source and measurement-condition verification remains incomplete.
The output is for research-stage pure-compound prescreening, not finished-fuel certification.
The public OOD record vectors may be linkable to a separately known source dataset.
